newsitem.title: USA: TWA matches Continental 50 pct fare cut.
newsitem.headline: TWA matches Continental 50 pct fare cut.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Monday it matched discounts of up to 50 percent made by Continental Airlines Inc on domestic flights and flights to Toronto and San Juan.
The discounts apply to routes competing with Continental.

Tickets purchased with the sale fare require a 14-day advance purchase and must be bought within three days of reservation. TWA said travel requires a Saturday night stay, and other restrictions apply.
Tickets must be purchased no later than October 24, and all travel must be completed by February 13, 1997, TWA said. Holiday blackout periods apply.
